input_messages.content: Hi there! I was hoping you could help me with an order I placed for my daughter. She hasn’t received it yet, and I’m a bit worried. Could you help me check where it was sent, if it’s still on the way, and maybe give me the tracking number? Also, I wanted to double-check the storage size of the tablet I ordered for her. And, if possible, I’d like to update my default shipping address to my daughter’s, so I don’t have to change it every time I send her something.
I actually can’t remember which email I used, sorry about that. But my name is Lucas Santos, and my zip code is 80239. I hope that helps!

I’m not sure about the order number, but I ordered a tablet and a couple of other things for my daughter not too long ago—maybe a week or two back. I think it should be the order with the tablet in it. Could you check which one that is? Sorry, my memory isn’t what it used to be.

By the way, thanks for helping me out. It’s nice to have someone to talk to, even if it’s just about orders and addresses.

Yes, that’s my daughter’s address—943 Maple Drive, Suite 356, Chicago, IL 60621. Please go ahead and make that my default shipping address.

Thank you for checking all those details for me. I guess the package was delivered, but she hasn’t mentioned getting it yet. Maybe I’ll give her a call after this. Sometimes I worry she’s too busy to talk to her old man, you know? Anyway, I appreciate you taking the time to help me out.

Thank you so much for your help. I really appreciate it. I’ll reach out to my daughter and see if she got the package—maybe she just forgot to mention it. It’s nice to have someone to chat with, even if it’s just for a few minutes. If I have any more questions, I’ll be sure to get in touch. Have a great day! 

###STOP###
